Package io.github.lord_of_nothing.game

Class GameStateHandler

java.lang.Object
io.github.lord_of_nothing.game.GameStateHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResourceStateMutator, ResourceStateView
public class GameStateHandler extends Object implements ResourceStateMutator
Owns and exposes game-state lifecycle responsibilities.
